rows.rationale: The frozen audit marks this as the range's sole patch-equivalent commit. Both commits produce stable patch-id 1a064aa40b799932dfce02b52ee3b25d0510ee3e and change the same eight files with identical behavior: canonical auto_review output, legacy guardian_subagent input, and active reviewer propagation into delegated agents.

The baseline refresh_curated_plugin_cache checks the active cache version before marketplace membership and only warns when a configured plugin source is absent. It has no raw marketplace name loader, cache uninstall path, or removed-plugin regression test. The behavior is applicable local cache hygiene and leaves user configuration untouched.

The baseline writes the global remote catalog cache after a synchronous fetch and uses cached entries for recommendations, but plugin/list always awaits fetch_remote_marketplaces and has no cache-presence check or background-refresh option. The optimization is applicable, with future implementation preserving Every Code's existing auth-isolated cache key and remote route.
